_doc: Color probes (PLANO §8.3, R3 §3.2). sRGB 0-255 targets from colors.py / RESEARCH_SKETCHUP §4.2; tolerance per channel. Used by tests/sketchup_mode/gui/scn_sondas.py. 'pending' = needs a tool not merged yet.

sky_top.where: viewport, 3% below the top edge (depends on pitch)

horizon.where: viewport, just above the horizon line

face_back.where: centre of a ground rectangle drawn with Linha (back side up)

edge.where: on a drawn edge (1 pt, anti-aliased)

face_front_box.where: front face of the default box

face_side_box.where: side face of the default box
